name: graph-client-monorepo
description: Multi-provider graph database client — Neptune, Neo4j, JanusGraph, ArangoDB, and more

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/electron/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/renderer/tsconfig.json
scripts.compile: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/core && npm run compile -w apps/electron
scripts.start: npm run compile && npm run bundle && electron apps/electron/dist/main.js
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:mac: npm run compile && npm run bundle && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:mac:local: npm run compile && npm run bundle && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:win: npm run compile && npm run bundle && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:linux: npm run compile && npm run bundle && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.cjs
